verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents 'MCP Compatibility' and a probe confirms an official MCP server page exists, but the evidence pack gives no detail on how an external agent actually connects to AnythingLLM via that server, no independent/hands-on corroboration, and the docs elsewhere emphasize AnythingLLM consuming MCP servers (client role) rather than exposing itself as a server for other agents. missing for 10: concrete server-connection docs/examples, independent verification of the server endpoint, clarity distinguishing client vs. server MCP roles.
